You have +40 armor against physical damage. {{gray|You have {{gr|24|12|-}} armor against elemental damage.}} }} {{Skill progression |attribute = [[Inspiration Magic]] |var1 name = [[Duration]] |var1 at0 = 30 |var1 at15 = 90 |var2 name = - [[Armor rating|Armor]] against [[elemental damage]] |var2 at0 = 24 |var2 at15 = 12}} == Acquisition == '''[[Skill trainer]]s''' * [[Taltosh]] ([[Grendich Courthouse]]) * [[Captain Osric]] ([[Yak's Bend]]) * [[Dakk]] ([[Ember Light Camp]]) '''[[Signet of Capture]]''' * [[Mursaat Mesmer (boss)|Mursaat Mesmer]] ([[Ice Floe]]) * [[Balasi the Arcane]] ([[Iron Mines of Moladune]]) * [[Pantheras The Deceiver]] ([[Thunderhead Keep]]) == Related skills == * {{skill icon|Elemental Resistance}} * {{skill icon|Mantra of Earth}} * {{skill icon|Mantra of Flame}} * {{skill icon|Mantra of Frost}} * {{skill icon|Mantra of Lightning}} == Notes == * In [[PvP]], most physical damage characters carry an elemental damage weapon for use against [[Warrior]]s (who often have less armor against elemental damage). This stance can be quite dangerous to use since, upon seeing it used, attackers can simply [[weapon swap|swap weapons]]. * This skill is often used by Warriors when [[farming]] in [[the Underworld]]. {{bug|Similar to [[Cracked Armor]], this skill will not lower your armor rating below 60 or your [[List of armor effects by category#Equipment|"core" armor]] rating, if your "core" armor rating is lower than 60.}} {{bug|If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that, after subtraction of the penalty from Physical Resistance, still grants +26 or more armor rating against elemental damage, Physical Resistance's armor penalty does not function. See also [[armor calculation]].}}
